_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::structural_dynamics#9 — RESTARTEVERY is declared in BOTH the IO section (src/inpar/4C_inpar_io.cpp, default -1) and STRUCTURAL DYNAMIC (src/inpar/4C_inpar_structure.cpp), but the structural integrator reads only the STRUCTURAL DYNAMIC one (src/structure_new/src/4C_structure_new_timint_basedataio.cpp:81). Under IO the run parses, exits 0 and writes ZERO out.result.structure.s* records; the later --restart=2 then fails with "No restart entry for discretization 'structure' step 2 in control file". Under STRUCTURAL DYNAMIC one record is written and --restart=2 resumes ('Restart of the structural simulation from step 2') and exits 0. Verified by execution 2026-08-03 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf).
